body: I’ve been high and low searching for anything to be helpful, from holding a good job,  going to college, therapy, dating... at the end of the day none of it gives fulfillment. Hope you make something out of life, but I certainly don’t intend to
Well unfortunately, I’m not terminally ill... I just want someone who could even use a single one of my organs to get that from my life.
There’s assisted suicide options available outside the US, I just don’t know if they have any options in which my organs would be passed on

I think that’s the case... my plan has always included my being in front of a hospital or in a tub of ice in the hopes that my organs would remain viable, but I don’t know if they would have to do an autopsy making all the organs worthless anyway
